column1: # Focused table for the debug-function removal measurement.
# The removed work was two whole-moleculeList loops per timestep, so the gain
# scales with molecules x timesteps relative to total runtime.  These six cases
# span 100 to 3,955 molecules and 2,000 to 150,000 iterations, which is the
# range over which that ratio varies in cases.tsv.
# rev_2D is deliberately absent: roughly 40 s of its runtime is fixed 2D
# lookup-table construction regardless of iteration count, so it dilutes any
# per-timestep effect and costs 80 s per repetition pair to measure.
# Columns: id <TAB> input directory (under sample_inputs/) <TAB> parm file <TAB> nItr
